title: Woodford Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical locations, urgent treatment centres, and hazard guidance for Woodford, South Woodford, and Woodford Green.
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 first. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: Whipps Cross University Hospital, Whipps Cross Road, Leytonstone, London E11 1NR (from South Woodford station: ~30 min walk southwest via Hermon Hill and Whipps Cross Road, or bus W12 towards Walthamstow). King George Hospital, Barley Lane, Goodmayes, Ilford IG3 8YB (from South Woodford station: bus 179 south to Ilford, then bus 86 east along High Road). For designated Major Trauma care, the regional centre is The Royal London Hospital, Whitechapel Road, London E1 1FR (Central line from South Woodford or Woodford to Stratford, then Elizabeth line to Whitechapel). 2. Urgent Treatment Centres: Whipps Cross Urgent Treatment Centre, Whipps Cross Road, Leytonstone, London E11 1NR (co-located at Whipps Cross Hospital). 3. Area Hazards: The River Roding runs directly through the Woodford corridor adjacent to the M11; flood risk zones exist along Chigwell Road, Broadmead Road, and Charlie Brown's Roundabout during heavy rain. 4. Supplies: Supermarkets and retail pharmacies along George Lane in South Woodford and The Broadway / High Road in Woodford Green supply emergency water, hygiene items, and first-aid kits during disruptions. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
